nodes.body_text: abstract class HauyneDependency @Inject constructor(@get:Input val modId: String, @get:Input val type: DependencyKind) { @get:Input abstract val versionRange: Property<VersionRange> @get:Input abstract val ordering: Property<Ordering> @get:Input abstract val side: Property<Side> @get:Input @get:Optional abstract val reason: Property<String> @get:Input @get:Optional abstract val curseForgeSlug: Property<String> @get:Input @get:Optional abstract val modrinthSlug: Property<String> @get:Input @get:Optional abstract val curseForgeRelation: Property<DependencyType> @get:Input @get:Optional abstract val modrinthRelation: Property<DependencyType> @get:Input @get:Optional abstract val modrinthVersionId: Property<String> init { versionRange.convention(AnyVersion) ordering.convention(Ordering.NONE) side.convention(Side.BOTH) } internal fun relation(override: Property<DependencyType>): DependencyType? = override.orNull ?: when (type) { DependencyKind.REQUIRED -> DependencyType.REQUIRED DependencyKind.OPTIONAL -> DependencyType.OPTIONAL DependencyKind.INCOMPATIBLE -> DependencyType.INCOMPATIBLE DependencyKind.DISCOURAGED -> null } internal fun validate(owner: String, loader: HauyneFmlLoader) { val id = modId require(id.matches(Regex("[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,63}"))) { "Invalid FML dependency mod ID: $id" } require(id !in setOf(owner, "minecraft", loader.modId)) { "Reserved or self dependency: $id" } require(loader != HauyneFmlLoader.FORGE || type in setOf(DependencyKind.REQUIRED, DependencyKind.OPTIONAL)) { "Forge does not support $type dependencies: $id" } for ((slug, relation) in listOf(curseForgeSlug to curseForgeRelation, modrinthSlug to modrinthRelation)) { require(slug.orNull == null || slug.get().isNotBlank()) { "Empty dependency slug: $id" } require(!relation.isPresent || slug.isPresent) { "Dependency relation requires a slug: $id" } require(!slug.isPresent || relation(relation) != null) { "Discouraged dependency requires an explicit publication relation: $id" } } require(!modrinthVersionId.isPresent || (modrinthSlug.isPresent && modrinthVersionId.get().isNotBlank())) { "Modrinth version ID requires a slug and must not be blank: $id" } } }
